source_review: Exponent lemma uses the canonical denominator power and Nat.log2 lower bound to exclude the candidate decrement.
Scaling lemma rewrites rational absolute value and powers of two, with an explicit nonnegative integer exponent.
Round lemma handles zero, bounds numerator log2 and the clamped quantum, proves the scaled value is an integer and restores the original sign.
The statements quantify over all Rat values with explicit arithmetic hypotheses; no decoder, corpus, Float primitive or additional axiom appears.
